title.narrative: Managing malaria control program in Papua New Guinea - Papua New Guinea (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Papua New Guinea, Malaria, The Rotary Club of Port Moresby Inc. (RAM)This program has the following goals: Reduce malaria mortality (In-patient malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 persons per year from 2.53 in 2022 to 1.97 by 2026). The objectives of this program are: Malaria vector control and personal protection. Coverage of locally appropriate quality assured strategies for vector control and personal protection optimized nationwide.. Malaria case management. Universal access to quality assured early diagnosis and appropriate treatment.. Behaviour Change Communication. Community-based support for malaria control and elimination efforts mobilized and utilization of prevention and case management services maximized.. Surveillance and response. A strong routine disease surveillance and response system in burden reduction settings and a robust case-based surveillance and response system in elimination and prevention of re-establishment settings.. Enabling environment. A strong enabling environment for malaria control and elimination.
